# Style And Class London

> London Pre-Loved & Curated Vintage Fashion Boutique. Sustainable 1-of-1 pieces dispatched across the UK.

## About Us
Style And Class is an authentic London-based second-hand and pre-loved fashion boutique. Every piece is hand-inspected, authenticated, steam-pressed, and graded. All items are unique 1-of-1 pieces; once purchased, an item is immediately removed from the catalog.

## Store Information
- Website: https://styleandclass.store
- Merchant Email: styleandclasslondon@gmail.com
- Telephone / WhatsApp: +44 7591 878215
- Currency: British Pounds Sterling (GBP, £)
- Payment Methods: PayPal UK, Debit & Credit Card (Visa, Mastercard, Maestro, AMEX) via PayPal Gateway
- Delivery: UK-wide tracked delivery via Evri (£2.99), InPost Locker (£2.89), and Royal Mail (£3.49). Free shipping over £35.
- Returns: 7-day return policy for unwashed, unworn items in original packaging.

## Collections
- Women's Collection: Pre-loved designer dresses, blouses, knitwear, and trousers.
- Men's Vintage: Curated jackets, shirts, hoodies, and knitwear.
- Kids' Wear: Clean, gentle-wear children's apparel.
- Bags & Accessories: Authentic pre-loved handbags, scarves, and jewelry.

## Key Policies
- Direct WhatsApp Concierge: Instant customer support and order coordination.
- Automated Thermal Shipping: Generates 4×6 inch standard courier thermal labels.
- Secure Buyer Protection: Protected by PayPal Buyer Protection and UK Consumer Rights Act 2015.
